name: Exam
summary: A computer-based mock-test portal with 16 national and 15 state exam sets, day-wise papers, section tabs, a question palette, rough work pad, fractional negative marking and step-by-step solutions.
features: 16 national sets including SSC, UPSC, JEE, NEET, CTET, CUET, CA, NET and Judiciary
15 state sets across Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Rajasthan and Madhya Pradesh
90-day calendar with day unlock, resume, previous-day results and solutions
Previous / Doubt / Skip / Clear / Next controls plus a touch rough pad
Exact negative marking with decimal.js, including −1/3 and −2/3 patterns
Violation tracking, saved sessions, scorecard, solutions and progress tiers

name: Jap
tagline: A calm 108-bead counter with a Vedic clock
summary: An offline-first Rudraksha mala counter with selectable mala sizes, 159 mantras, tactile and audio feedback, Sankalp text, Panchang, Kundli preview and a scripture reader.
features: 108 / 54 / 27 / 21 bead cycles with animated Rudraksha ring and completion glow
159 searchable mantras across 11 categories plus custom mantra creation
Dexie-backed sessions, history, yajman records and queued background sync
Live Panchang: Tithi, Paksha, Nakshatra, Yoga, Karana, sunrise and moonrise
Kundli and Graha preview from astronomy-engine with a documented ayanamsa model
Sankalp generator and a reader for Hanuman Chalisa, Shiv Tandav, Gita and more

name: Music
tagline: Low-distraction listening, offline where it counts
summary: A distraction-free player with dual-deck crossfade, quality ladder, WebAudio equalizer, synced lyrics, playlists, sleep timer, wake lock and lock-screen media controls.
features: Dual-deck playback with requestAnimationFrame equal-power crossfade
Quality ladder with auto switching and exact resume timestamp
WebAudio EQ, live visualizer, sleep timer and screen wake lock
Lyrics tiers including LRCLIB, local LRC, offset calibration and tap-to-seek
Daily trending mix, POP100, singers hub, search and saved playlists
Offline service-worker vault with Range/206 support and MediaSession controls

name: Calculator
tagline: Exact money maths and practical measurement
summary: The all-in-one suite blueprint covers standard, scientific and programmer modes; land and room area; EMI, GST, FD, SIP and currency tools; commissions; and daily utilities with decimal.js for money.
features: Standard, scientific and programmer calculation modes with degree/radian support
Irregular land area, room paint and surface estimation with documented formulas
EMI, GST split, FD/RD, SIP, cash denomination and currency conversion tools
Flat, salary-plus, graduated and gross-margin commission calculators
Discount, split bill, travel cost, age and unit-conversion utilities
Dexie audit history, theme and install flows; money uses decimal.js half-up rounding
audience: Anyone checking a bill or tax split

name: Speed
tagline: Real throughput, loaded latency and local benchmarks
summary: A three-phase network test: multi-stream download, multi-stream upload and ping/jitter, with bufferbloat grading, Mbps plus real MB/s, ISP intelligence and hyper-local comparisons.
features: Automatic ping → download → upload sequence with stop, share and retry
6 concurrent download streams and 4 concurrent upload streams with p85 results
Loaded-ping probes for bufferbloat grading from A+ to D
Simultaneous Mbps and MB/s plus download-time estimators
Connection type, ISP/ASN normalisation and ~600 m geohash local benchmarks
Last 100 results with JSON/CSV export and a shareable 1080×540 result card

name: Cafe
tagline: USB-free document handoff for cyber cafés
summary: A customer and shopkeeper portal for form data and documents: permanent links, OTP gates, a debounced autosaving wizard, compressed uploads, signed presigning and an offline outbox.
features: Separate customer and shopkeeper entry with permanent link routing
Four-step form wizard with debounced autosave and conditional relation fields
Sequential document chain, WebP compression at 0.15 MB and legibility workflow
Six-digit offline PIN shards and 24-hour overwrite/keep-both versioning
Dexie stores with outbox flush on reconnect and blob caching
Rate-limited OTP endpoints, Turnstile checks, signed admin access and S3 presigning
